fields.FIR_Description: On 2026-04-24 at roughly 20:10, it was reported that the complainant scanned a QR code shared by a caller who spoke of a refund, and Rs. 12,000 was debited instead. Uma Raj submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000089. A witness, Padmini Raj, reachable on 9000000032, was mentioned in the complaint. Mathan Chandran (9000000343), described as a business acquaintance, was also mentioned in the complaint. Anand Muthu (mobile 9000000280) was named as a possible person of interest. The complainant mentioned the account SYN-ACC-100088 as the destination of the transfer. Potentially relevant material referenced includes a call detail reference.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Victim was allegedly induced to approve a collect request on a UPI app.
fields.Keywords: UPI fraud, online payment, associate, receiving account, evening, witness, suspect, main street
